description: This file defines the 'Information' model class in the OpenCart e-commerce system, providing methods to retrieve and manage information records from the database, such as fetching specific information, all information entries, and associated layout IDs.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Model class for managing 'information' records, including retrieving specific information entries, lists of information, and layout IDs.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Fetches a single information record based on its ID, joining description and store information.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Retrieves all information records applicable to the current store and language, with caching for efficiency.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Gets the layout ID associated with a specific information record.
